function.arguments:
{"command":"create","path":"/app/setup_ca.sh","file_text":"#!/bin/bash
# Certificate Authority Setup Script
# Creates a certificate hierarchy for artifact signing

set -e

# Directories
CA_DIR="/app/ca"
SIGNING_DIR="/app/signing"
SIGNED_DIR="/app/signed"

# Create directory structure
mkdir -p "$CA_DIR" "$SIGNING_DIR" "$SIGNED_DIR"

# Root CA configuration
ROOT_CA_CERT="$CA_DIR/root-ca.pem"
ROOT_CA_KEY="$CA_DIR/root-ca-key.pem"
ROOT_CA_SUBJECT="/CN=Software Signing Root CA/O=SecureBuild/C=US"

# Intermediate CA configuration
INTERMEDIATE_CA_CERT="$CA_DIR/intermediate-ca.pem"
INTERMEDIATE_CA_KEY="$CA_DIR/intermediate-ca-key.pem"
INTERMEDIATE_CA_SUBJECT="/CN=Build Pipeline Intermediate CA/O=SecureBuild/C=US"

echo "=== Setting up Certificate Authority Hierarchy ==="

# Generate Root CA private key
echo "Generating Root CA private key..."
openssl genpkey -algorithm EC -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 -out "$ROOT_CA_KEY"

# Create Root CA certificate (self-signed)
echo "Creating Root CA certificate..."
openssl req -new -x509 -days 3650 \
    -key "$ROOT_CA_KEY" \
    -out "$ROOT_CA_CERT" \
    -subj "$ROOT_CA_SUBJECT" \
    -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" \
    -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign"

echo "Root CA created: $ROOT_CA_CERT"

# Generate Intermediate CA private key
echo "Generating Intermediate CA private key..."
openssl genpkey -algorithm EC -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 -out "$INTERMEDIATE_CA_KEY"

# Create Intermediate CA CSR
echo "Creating Intermediate CA certificate signing request..."
openssl req -new -key "$INTERMEDIATE_CA_KEY" \
    -out "$CA_DIR/intermediate-ca.csr" \
    -subj "$INTERMEDIATE_CA_SUBJECT"

# Create Intermediate CA certificate signed by Root CA
echo "Signing Intermediate CA with Root CA..."
openssl x509 -req -days 1825 \
    -in "$CA_DIR/intermediate-ca.csr" \
    -CA "$ROOT_CA_CERT" \
    -CAkey "$ROOT_CA_KEY" \
    -CAcreateserial \
    -out "$INTERMEDIATE_CA_CERT" \
    -sha256 \
    -extfile <(echo -e "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE,pathlen:0\nkeyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,digitalSignature")

echo "Intermediate CA created: $INTERMEDIATE_CA_CERT"

# Clean up CSR file
rm -f "$CA_DIR/intermediate-ca.csr"

echo "=== CA Hierarchy Setup Complete ==="
echo "Root CA: $ROOT_CA_CERT"
echo "Intermediate CA: $INTERMEDIATE_CA_CERT"
"}
